name: WirelessPower-重制版
description: Wireless power transfer for Satisfactory 1.2. A wireless grid of peer nodes (Relay / Power Converter / Area Power Pole / Laser Tower) that share one power circuit across distance without cables. A newly built node joins the in-range grid by itself (distance based, no id needed) and inherits the nearest node's channel; the Area Power Pole also carries a real cable terminal like the original.
